# ADR-CLOUD-HARNESS-TEMPLATE-001 — Reusable Direct-Cloud Harness Runtime Template

## Status

specified (accepted; slice-1 adoption decision under `PROJECT-GTKB-CLOUD-HARNESS-TEMPLATE`). Authored from GO'd bridge proposal `gtkb-cloud-harness-template-slice1-adr` (Loyal Opposition GO at `-002`, Antigravity C, independent session).

## Context

GT-KB integrates cloud AI models as dispatchable Loyal Opposition / Prime Builder harnesses. Today each is a separately hand-rolled Python shim — `ollama_harness.py` (~1164 lines), `openrouter_harness.py` (~1312), `cursor_harness.py` (~490), plus the retired goose shim — that each re-implements connection, retry/backoff, the fail-closed guard adapter, author-metadata injection, and the tool-call loop. The two largest are near-duplicates. This duplication produces drift (divergent retry maturity, divergent guard details) and re-derived conventions — the exact failure mode `SPEC-INTAKE-9ec893` warns against.

`SPEC-INTAKE-9ec893` establishes that a harness = (integration + model + configuration) and that GT-KB prefers non-GUI, maximal-hook, direct-cloud integrations. A review of three harnesses spans the design matrix:

| Harness | Direct cloud | Auth | API dialect | Hook tier |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ollama (D) | no (localhost bridge) | none | native `/api/chat` | guard-adapter floor |
| OpenRouter (F) | yes (`openrouter.ai/api/v1`) | token via Authorization header (`OPENROUTER_API_KEY`) | OpenAI `/chat/completions` | guard-adapter floor |
| Alibaba Cloud Studio (H) | yes (target) | token via Authorization header (`ALIBABA_API_KEY`) | Anthropic `/v1/messages` | native full-hook target |

The shape is identical; only `{endpoint, auth-env-key, API dialect, model, hook tier}` vary. Owner decision `DELIB-20260708-BUILD-REUSABLE-DIRECT-CLOUD-HARNESS-TEMPLATE` directs building the reusable template as a first-class (not deferred) effort, with OpenRouter as the first adopter/proof.

## Decision

Adopt a single, config-driven **cloud harness runtime base** that all cloud harnesses instantiate, replacing the per-harness hand-rolled shims. The base owns connection, retry/backoff, fail-closed guard-adapter enforcement, author-metadata injection, and the tool-call loop. Adopters supply configuration only, across these varying axes:

- `endpoint` — the direct-cloud base URL (no local-service bridge).
- `auth-env-key` — token authentication via an Authorization header keyed on the adopter's `.env.local` env var, referenced by NAME only (`GOV-ENV-LOCAL-AUTHORITY-001`).
- `API dialect` — one of `ollama-native`, `openai-chat`, or `anthropic-messages`.
- `model` routing.
- `hook tier` — guard-adapter floor for OpenAI/native dialects; native full hooks where the `anthropic-messages` dialect and endpoint support it.

The base runtime enforces the `GOV-HARNESS-ONBOARDING-CONTRACT-001` Layer-3 fail-closed guard adapter for every adopter by construction, generalizing `DCL-OLLAMA-TOOL-PARITY-GATE-001` into a shared tool-parity constraint (authored in a later slice). **OpenRouter (F) is the first adopter/proof**: it is already direct-cloud + token-auth + OpenAI dialect + guard-adapter floor with mature retry/backoff, so re-basing it onto the shared runtime validates the base against a real consumer before Alibaba Cloud Studio and Ollama adopt it.

## Rationale

- **Consolidation prevents drift.** ~2,900 duplicated lines (Ollama + OpenRouter alone) collapse to one base plus thin per-harness config; OpenRouter's retry/backoff maturity and the guard-adapter floor become guarantees every adopter inherits rather than per-shim accidents.
- **Single point of governance enforcement.** The Layer-3 fail-closed guard adapter is enforced once, in the base, for all adopters — directly addressing the hookless-harness governance-bypass class demonstrated by the Goose incident (`DELIB-20260708-GOOSE-GOV-BYPASS-INCIDENT`).
- **Maximal hooks are a template capability, not a per-harness reinvention.** The `anthropic-messages` dialect path targets native full hooks (Claude-Code-style), lifting the hook ceiling above the guard-adapter floor once, for any adopter whose endpoint supports it.
- **The template is extracted from three real harnesses spanning the matrix**, so the varying-axes set is empirically minimal rather than speculative.

## Rejected Alternatives

- **Keep per-harness hand-rolled shims.** Rejected — ~2,900 duplicate lines, divergent maturity, and re-derived conventions; the drift the principle exists to prevent.
- **Reference-first extraction (build one harness, extract later).** Rejected by owner AUQ in favor of template + first-adopter, because reference-first risks the divergence the shims already exhibit.
- **Heavyweight agent-framework dependency.** Rejected — the existing shims are deliberately framework-free (per `ADR-OLLAMA-HARNESS-ADOPTION-001`); a framework would add a large dependency surface for a bounded runtime.

## Consequences

- **Slice plan:** slice 2 — shared runtime base module + OpenRouter re-base (proof) with regression tests, no shim deleted until its adopter passes on the base; slice 3 — dialect abstraction incl. `anthropic-messages` + native-hook path + generalized tool-parity DCL; slice 4 — sibling adoptions (Alibaba Cloud Studio, Ollama re-based), remaining shim consolidation (incl. Cursor), doctor + parity + tests.
- The per-harness slice-1 ADRs (`ADR-ALIBABA-CLOUD-STUDIO-HARNESS-ADOPTION-001`, `ADR-OLLAMA-DIRECT-CLOUD-HARNESS-ADOPTION-001`) reference this template and build their implementation slices on the shared runtime rather than hand-rolling.
- **Risk (premature abstraction):** mitigated by the OpenRouter first-adopter proof before sibling adoption, and by keeping the config surface to the minimal varying-axes set.
- **Risk (consolidation regression):** mitigated by re-basing one harness at a time behind the guard-adapter floor with regression tests.

## References

`SPEC-INTAKE-9ec893`; `DELIB-20260708-BUILD-REUSABLE-DIRECT-CLOUD-HARNESS-TEMPLATE`; `GOV-HARNESS-ONBOARDING-CONTRACT-001`; `DCL-OLLAMA-TOOL-PARITY-GATE-001`; `ADR-OLLAMA-HARNESS-ADOPTION-001`; `GOV-ENV-LOCAL-AUTHORITY-001`; bridge `gtkb-cloud-harness-template-slice1-adr` (GO at `-002`).
